chunks: WHATEVER IS IN the heavens and the earth sings the praises of God. He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as a reference to the natural prostration of all creation (including angels, jinn, and humans), underscores the concept of 'tasbih' as an inherent state of existence rather than merely a ritual act. It connects the cosmic order to divine wisdom (Hikmah), suggesting that every entity reflects a specific attribute of the All-Mighty (Al-Aziz) and All-Wise (Al-Hakim). This universal glorification serves as a theological basis for the belief that the entire universe is in a state of continuous worship and submission to God's will.
